description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - The Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (Amended issuance of Certificate of Exemption)
reasoning: This gazette notification is a legal/regulatory matter issued by the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (amended). It contains statutory notices regarding the issuance of Certificates of Exemption from licensing requirements for electricity distribution and supply, which falls under regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements. This does not involve government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories, making it a clear Legal/Regulatory gazette.
